/*BATCH batchMarketStockList*/ SELECT TSIS.STOCK_ID, TSIW.STOCK_CODE, TO_CHAR(TSSA.MODIFY_DATE, (CASE WHEN #{stock_country_code}='KR' THEN 'YYYYMMDDHH24' ELSE 'YYYYMMDD' END )) AS MODIFY_DATE FROM TB_S_INTEREST_WATCHLIST TSIW LEFT JOIN ${analysisTable} TSSA ON TSIW.STOCK_CODE = TSSA.STOCK_CODE INNER JOIN TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK TSIS ON TSIW.STOCK_CODE = TSIS.STOCK_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND TSIS.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE = #{stock_country_code} AND TSIW.STOCK_GROUP='0000'
AND ROWNUM <= TO_NUMBER(#{limit})
AND (TSSA.MODIFY_DATE IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(TSSA.MODIFY_DATE, (CASE WHEN #{stock_country_code}='KR' THEN 'YYYYMMDDHH24' ELSE 'YYYYMMDD' END )) != TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, (CASE WHEN #{stock_country_code}='KR' THEN 'YYYYMMDDHH24' ELSE 'YYYYMMDD' END )))
GROUP BY TSIS.STOCK_ID, TSIW.STOCK_CODE, TSSA.STOCK_CLOSE, TSSA.MODIFY_DATE ORDER BY CASE WHEN MODIFY_DATE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, MODIFY_DATE

/*BATCH GroupOrderStockList*/ SELECT TSIS.STOCK_ID, TSIS.STOCK_CODE, TSIS.STOCK_KO_NAME, TO_CHAR(TSSA.MODIFY_DATE, (CASE WHEN #{stock_country_code}='KR' THEN 'YYYYMMDDHH24' ELSE 'YYYYMMDD' END )) AS MODIFY_DATE FROM TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK TSIS LEFT JOIN ${analysisTable} TSSA ON TSIS.STOCK_CODE = TSSA.STOCK_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND TSIS.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE = #{stock_country_code}
AND ( TSIS.STOCK_TYPE = '300' OR TSIS.STOCK_TYPE = 'stock' OR TSIS.STOCK_TYPE = 'index' ) AND ( TSIS.STOCK_TYPE_SPECS IN ('ST','CS','null') OR TSIS.STOCK_TYPE_SPECS IS NULL )
AND TSIS.STOCK_TYPE IN ('stock', 'index') AND (TSIS.STOCK_TYPE_SPECS IN ('CS','null') OR TSIS.STOCK_TYPE_SPECS IS NULL)
and ( TSIS.STOCK_ALIASES = 'snp500' OR INSTR(NVL(TSIS.STOCK_ALIASES,''), 'snp500') > 0 OR INSTR(NVL(TSIS.STOCK_ALIASES,''), 'market_regime') > 0 OR INSTR(NVL(TSIS.STOCK_ALIASES,''), 'market_regime_proxy') > 0 )
AND (TSSA.STOCK_CLOSE IS NULL OR TO_NUMBER(TSSA.STOCK_CLOSE) BETWEEN #{start_price} AND #{end_price})
AND (TSSA.MODIFY_DATE IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(TSSA.MODIFY_DATE, (CASE WHEN #{stock_country_code}='KR' THEN 'YYYYMMDDHH24' ELSE 'YYYYMMDD' END )) != TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, (CASE WHEN #{stock_country_code}='KR' THEN 'YYYYMMDDHH24' ELSE 'YYYYMMDD' END )))
AND TSIS.USE_DIV = 'Y'
AND ROWNUM <= TO_NUMBER(#{limit})
GROUP BY TSIS.STOCK_ID, TSIS.STOCK_CODE, TSIS.STOCK_KO_NAME, TSSA.STOCK_CLOSE, TSSA.MODIFY_DATE ORDER BY CASE WHEN MODIFY_DATE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, MODIFY_DATE
mapper.insert: /*MERGE ${analysisTable}*/ MERGE INTO ${analysisTable} T USING ( SELECT #{stock_code} AS stock_code ,#{stock_mon} AS stock_mon ,#{stock_sma5} AS stock_sma5 ,#{stock_sma20} AS stock_sma20 ,#{stock_sma60} AS stock_sma60 ,#{stock_sma120} AS stock_sma120 ,#{stock_sma240} AS stock_sma240 ,#{stock_sma5_price} AS stock_sma5_price ,#{stock_sma20_price} AS stock_sma20_price ,#{stock_sma60_price} AS stock_sma60_price ,#{stock_sma120_price} AS stock_sma120_price ,#{stock_sma240_price} AS stock_sma240_price ,#{stock_sma5_mon_price} AS stock_sma5_mon_price ,#{stock_macd_time} AS stock_macd_time ,#{stock_macd_timedays} AS stock_macd_timedays ,#{stock_macd_signal} AS stock_macd_signal ,#{stock_macd_streaksignal} AS stock_macd_streaksignal ,#{stock_macd_streakdays} AS stock_macd_streakdays ,#{stock_sma_lines} AS stock_sma_lines ,#{stock_av_volume} AS stock_av_volume ,#{stock_av_volumesignal} AS stock_av_volumesignal ,#{stock_close} AS stock_close FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.STOCK_CODE = S.STOCK_CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.STOCK_MON = S.STOCK_MON, T.STOCK_SMA5 = S.STOCK_SMA5, T.STOCK_SMA20 = S.STOCK_SMA20, T.STOCK_SMA60 = S.STOCK_SMA60, T.STOCK_SMA120 = S.STOCK_SMA120, T.STOCK_SMA240 = S.STOCK_SMA240, T.STOCK_SMA5_PRICE = S.STOCK_SMA5_PRICE, T.STOCK_SMA20_PRICE = S.STOCK_SMA20_PRICE, T.STOCK_SMA60_PRICE = S.STOCK_SMA60_PRICE, T.STOCK_SMA120_PRICE = S.STOCK_SMA120_PRICE, T.STOCK_SMA240_PRICE = S.STOCK_SMA240_PRICE, T.STOCK_SMA5_MON_PRICE = S.STOCK_SMA5_MON_PRICE, T.STOCK_MACD_TIME = S.STOCK_MACD_TIME, T.STOCK_MACD_TIMEDAYS = S.STOCK_MACD_TIMEDAYS, T.STOCK_MACD_SIGNAL = S.STOCK_MACD_SIGNAL, T.STOCK_MACD_STREAKSIGNAL = S.STOCK_MACD_STREAKSIGNAL, T.STOCK_MACD_STREAKDAYS = S.STOCK_MACD_STREAKDAYS, T.STOCK_SMA_LINES = S.STOCK_SMA_LINES, T.STOCK_AV_VOLUME = S.STOCK_AV_VOLUME, T.STOCK_AV_VOLUMESIGNAL = S.STOCK_AV_VOLUMESIGNAL, T.STOCK_CLOSE = S.STOCK_CLOSE, T.MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( STOCK_CODE ,STOCK_MON ,STOCK_SMA5 ,STOCK_SMA20 ,STOCK_SMA60 ,STOCK_SMA120 ,STOCK_SMA240 ,STOCK_SMA5_PRICE ,STOCK_SMA20_PRICE ,STOCK_SMA60_PRICE ,STOCK_SMA120_PRICE ,STOCK_SMA240_PRICE ,STOCK_SMA5_MON_PRICE ,STOCK_MACD_TIME ,STOCK_MACD_TIMEDAYS ,STOCK_MACD_SIGNAL ,STOCK_MACD_STREAKSIGNAL ,STOCK_MACD_STREAKDAYS ,STOCK_SMA_LINES ,STOCK_AV_VOLUME ,STOCK_AV_VOLUMESIGNAL ,STOCK_CLOSE ,CREATE_DATE )VALUES ( S.STOCK_CODE ,S.STOCK_MON ,S.STOCK_SMA5 ,S.STOCK_SMA20 ,S.STOCK_SMA60 ,S.STOCK_SMA120 ,S.STOCK_SMA240 ,S.STOCK_SMA5_PRICE ,S.STOCK_SMA20_PRICE ,S.STOCK_SMA60_PRICE ,S.STOCK_SMA120_PRICE ,S.STOCK_SMA240_PRICE ,S.STOCK_SMA5_MON_PRICE ,S.STOCK_MACD_TIME ,S.STOCK_MACD_TIMEDAYS ,S.STOCK_MACD_SIGNAL ,S.STOCK_MACD_STREAKSIGNAL ,S.STOCK_MACD_STREAKDAYS ,S.STOCK_SMA_LINES ,S.STOCK_AV_VOLUME ,S.STOCK_AV_VOLUMESIGNAL ,S.STOCK_CLOSE ,SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK SET USE_DIV = 'N' ,MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE STOCK_CODE = #{stock_code}
mapper.select: /*BATCH batchGroupOrderStockConsensusList*/ SELECT TSIS.STOCK_ID, TSIS.STOCK_CODE, TSIS.STOCK_KO_NAME, TO_CHAR(TSSC.MODIFY_DATE,'YYYYMM') AS MODIFY_DATE FROM TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK TSIS LEFT JOIN TB_S_STOCK_CONSENSUS TSSC ON TSIS.STOCK_CODE = TSSC.STOCK_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND TSIS.USE_DIV = 'Y' AND TSIS.STOCK_TYPE IN ('stock', 'index') AND TSIS.STOCK_TYPE_SPECS IN ('CS','null') AND TSIS.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE = 'KR' AND (TSSC.MODIFY_DATE IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(TSSC.MODIFY_DATE, 'YYYYMM') != TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMM')) GROUP BY TSIS.STOCK_ID, TSIS.STOCK_CODE, TSIS.STOCK_KO_NAME, TSSC.MODIFY_DATE ORDER BY CASE WHEN MODIFY_DATE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, MODIFY_DATE

/*BATCH batchGroupStockConsensusList*/ SELECT TSIS.STOCK_ID, TSIW.STOCK_CODE, TO_CHAR(TSSC.MODIFY_DATE, 'YYYYMM') AS MODIFY_DATE FROM TB_S_INTEREST_WATCHLIST TSIW LEFT JOIN TB_S_STOCK_CONSENSUS TSSC ON TSIW.STOCK_CODE = TSSC.STOCK_CODE INNER JOIN TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK TSIS ON TSIW.STOCK_CODE = TSIS.STOCK_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND TSIS.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE = 'KR' AND (TSSC.MODIFY_DATE IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(TSSC.MODIFY_DATE, 'YYYYMM') != TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMM')) GROUP BY TSIS.STOCK_ID, TSIW.STOCK_CODE, TSSC.MODIFY_DATE ORDER BY CASE WHEN MODIFY_DATE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, MODIFY_DATE
mapper.insert: /*MERGE mergeStockConsensus*/ MERGE INTO TB_S_STOCK_CONSENSUS T USING ( SELECT #{stock_code} AS stock_code ,#{sales_trend} AS sales_trend ,#{sales_difference} AS sales_difference ,#{op_trend} AS op_trend ,#{op_difference} AS op_difference ,#{eps_trend} AS eps_trend ,#{eps_difference} AS eps_difference FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.STOCK_CODE = S.STOCK_CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.SALES_TREND = S.SALES_TREND, T.SALES_DIFFERENCE = S.SALES_DIFFERENCE, T.OP_TREND = S.OP_TREND, T.OP_DIFFERENCE = S.OP_DIFFERENCE, T.EPS_TREND = S.EPS_TREND, T.EPS_DIFFERENCE = S.EPS_DIFFERENCE, T.MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( STOCK_CODE ,SALES_TREND ,SALES_DIFFERENCE ,OP_TREND ,OP_DIFFERENCE ,EPS_TREND ,EPS_DIFFERENCE ,MODIFY_DATE ,CREATE_DATE )VALUES ( S.STOCK_CODE ,S.SALES_TREND ,S.SALES_DIFFERENCE ,S.OP_TREND ,S.OP_DIFFERENCE ,S.EPS_TREND ,S.EPS_DIFFERENCE ,SYSDATE ,SYSDATE )
